note: The runs adapted for the published page, per experiment. An experiment's key is its id in overlay.json; evidence_folder is a folder's name, never a path. One call adapts every experiment and development run: python3 tools/adapt_run.py --evidence FOLDER, where FOLDER holds the evidence folders. The example (invented numbers) is no evidence and is not listed here: its run folder is the fixture the run-fixture tool writes, added with a second call, python3 tools/adapt_run.py --experiment example-sheet --root tests/fixtures/run-example --run invented-numbers. Nothing generated is committed. Held back: the W1 heredity pilot (evidence folder heredity-pilot-w1-20261110-01; runs pilot-04/world-1, pilot-04/world-2) adapts, but is not shown yet, because the view draws every event as a replacement and the pilot's events are a cue switched on and off in many cells at once. Add it back as an experiment here when the view can draw a cue.

e07-v1.note: All 38 runs of the judged experiment. The first three are one of the inheritance route, which the judged result is about, and the control at two couplings; the rest follow in the order of the experiment's summary.

heredity-turnover-literature.note: All 21 arms that have an outcome: the isolated newcomers first, then the donor copies, each in the order of the experiment's summary. Three folders that an out-of-memory kill left without an outcome are not runs and are not listed.

secreted-species-dev-run.note: The engine's first development run for the viewer (15 November 2026): one run, no verdict.

planarian-loop.note: FR-11's first looping run (16 November 2026): the interim planarian loop as the engine's run-view writer wrote it after adopting the engine's own view declarations (b08af640, the writer on main since 050aa741); one run, no verdict.

gap-junction-linear-network.note: The engine side's run folder for the viewer: its index.json chooses the arms (runs: index), so arms added there later are data alone. The folder is named folder by folder (within), never as a path; move the run folder by changing within. It names dev-06, the run that packages every arm that fits the engine side's layer limit (17 November 2026).

gap-junction-tissue-line.note: The example's tissue line (17 November 2026): the engine side's run folder of the five picks. It has no index.json, so its arms are its packages that hold a view.json; the two picks an engine check refused hold a REFUSED.json and no view, and are named from it.
